content: आलीढ {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [आ-लिह्-क्त] .²1 Licked, eaten, lapped, scraped. .²2 Wounded, hurt; सेनान्यमालीढमिवासुरास्त्रैः <ls>R. 2. 37</ls>. .²3 Closed (as in sleep) <ls>Dk. 117</ls>. .{@-ढम्@} A particular attitude in shooting, the right knee being advanced and the left leg retracted; अतिष्ठदालीढविशेषशोभिना <ls>R. 3. 52</ls>; see <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 3. 70</ls>.
